Definition: Berekjah, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Berechiah means "Jehovah blesses." The name is shared by several bearers: A son of Zerubbabel; A Levite who returned for the exile; The father of Meshullam, one of Nehemiah's chiefs who assisted in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem; The father of Zechariah; A Gershonite Levite, the father of Asaph, the singer, doorkeeper of the ark; An Ephraimite chief in the time of Ahaz. It turns up in 1 Chronicles 3:20, 1 Chronicles 6:39 and 1 Chronicles 9:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God kept Berechiah in the record on purpose, and that is reason enough to know it.
